# Infosys Foundation

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Official Infosys Foundation (infosys.org) and Infosys Limited (infosys.com) domains, and Scribd, consistently returned HTTP 403 / HELD to automated reads and fetches despite several being marked READABLE in search, blocking access to the primary CSR annexure, foundation annual reports, and CSR policy pages. Research relied on secondary sources (Wikipedia, UNESCO, INAE, India CSR) instead; identifiers (CIN/PAN/CSR-1/Darpan), a foundation-only csr_year figure, contact details, and NGO application/RFP process could not be found within budget.

Infosys Foundation, established 1996, is the CSR/philanthropic arm of Infosys Limited (Bengaluru-headquartered, non-profit, solely funded by Infosys with no external donations accepted per Wikipedia). It runs five historical thematic verticals - education, healthcare, rural development, arts & culture, destitute care - plus an environmental sustainability line seen in recent CSR reporting. Confirmed recent activity: a December 2024 commitment of over INR 38 crore to INAE for the Centre for Engineering Education Excellence (CEEE) program across nine IITs over four years; Infosys Springboard digital literacy programme with STEM labs/scholarships via Ramakrishna Mission schools; healthcare capital support to PGIMER Chandigarh and an AIIMS mother-and-child block; Bengaluru lake rejuvenation; and a 2025 press release (headline only, body blocked) citing an over INR 48 crore commitment to maternal/child healthcare in rural Karnataka. Infosys Limited's own FY2023-24 CSR annexure (via secondary source) shows Rs 450.76 crore spent and Rs 39.54 crore unspent/carried forward, but this was deliberately NOT written into the Foundation's own csr_year record, to avoid merging the listed parent company's statutory obligation with the separate foundation entity. Primary sources (infosys.org, infosys.com, scribd) were largely inaccessible (403/HELD) during this session, so registration identifiers, contact details, application process, RFP status and eligibility criteria for NGOs remain not found.

Website: https://www.infosys.org

## What it set out to find

- identity: legal name, registration type, parent relationship to Infosys Limited, website, funder_type
- identifiers: CIN, PAN, CSR-1, domain
- csr_year: FY2023-24/24-25/25-26 Section 135 prescribed CSR, spend, overheads, unspent, impact assessment (for Infosys Limited, the Section-135-bound parent) and any Foundation-only disclosed totals
- csr_spend: project/aggregate level detail across verticals
- footprint: state/district where projects actually ran
- stated_geography: declared priority areas from CSR policy
- partner: named implementing NGOs/agencies/hospitals/universities per programme per FY
- grant: recipient, title, amount, dates, status
- program: theme > programme > phase > project hierarchy
- metric: beneficiary counts/outputs with stage and method
- contact: publicly disclosed CSR/grants contact
- document: annual reports / CSR annexure / foundation reports
